name: jls2-logtrie-public-validation-scorecard
title: JLS2 JSON/log one-time public validation
result_summary: Strong unseen ratio win over zstd-9 and PBC-only, but the frozen overall gate failed Brotli family coverage and decompression speed.
claim_ceiling: One-time unseen public LogTrie family evidence only; not independent-corpus, market-leading, world-best, or state-of-the-art evidence.

candidate.portable_ci: Linux, macOS, and Windows standard CI passed on the scored commit

standards.compression_basis: five complete trials; aggregate source bytes divided by sum of family medians
standards.decompression_basis: five complete trials; aggregate source bytes divided by sum of family medians
standards.memory_basis: not measured in this validation; development worst-case RSS was 386.4 MB compression and 171.4 MB decompression

standards.compression_basis: one complete baseline trial per family
standards.decompression_basis: one complete baseline trial per family
standards.speed_comparability: same host and bytes, but baseline timing is single-trial context rather than a repeated speed gate

standards.compression_basis: one complete baseline trial per family
standards.decompression_basis: one complete baseline trial per family
standards.jls2_size_outcome: mixed: 4.58% smaller in aggregate but smaller on only 1 of 3 families
standards.speed_comparability: same host and bytes, but baseline timing is single-trial context rather than a repeated speed gate

standards.compression_basis: two pattern-training trials plus five online trials; complete rate includes median training and median online time
standards.jls2_compression_outcome: win: 277.72x faster than complete training plus online rate; 1.76x faster than online-only rate
standards.speed_comparability: same hosted runner and bytes in a separate quiet-host stage; PBC training deliberately uses 64 threads on 4 logical CPUs

decision: Retain the failed first score. Do not tune or rerun JLS2 on these validation families. Preserve the ratio representation as validated evidence, profile Linux decode using development data only, and require a fresh independently sourced corpus for any successor claim.
